Name: Old Farmer Brand Electric Fish Machine

[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]
Old Farmer Brand Electric Fish Machine. Fish in Electric Water .

[b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b]
First, install SMAPI, then download and unzip this mod to the Mods folder in the game.
[heading][b][size=4]Main Features[/size]
[/b][size=3]Old Farmer Brand Electric Fish Machine V1.0.0 Introduction (For Maximum Fun)[/size][/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Willy’s store sells recipes for making electric fish machines, priced at 66666g. .[/*]
[*]Materials: 99 hardwood pieces+99 copper ingots+99 silver ingots+99 gold ingots+1 Prismatic Shard.[/*]
[*]Battery is required to start, and the usage method is the same as that of a fishing buoy.[/*]
[*]For every battery consumed by the electric fishing machine, you can gain fishing experience.[/*]
[*]Electric fishing will generate corresponding fish species based on your fishing level.[/*]
[*]When used, it may cause electric shock and loss of health points. Please use it with caution!!![/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Shout outs[/size][/b]
小红书账号：鹈鹕镇的小凯（创意、程序）、slllllqz（美术支持）
[line]
[b][size=4]介绍[/size][/b]
老农民牌电鱼机，电晕水里的鱼。
[size=4][b]安装说明[/b][/size]
先安装SMAPI，然后下载本Mod解压复制到游戏的 Mods 文件夹。
[size=4][b]主要功能[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]威利商店出售电鱼机制作配方，售价 66666g。[/*]
[*]制作材料：99 个硬木 + 99 个铜锭 + 99 个银锭 + 99 个金锭 + 1 个五彩碎片。[/*]
[*]需装备电池方可启动，使用方式与钓鱼浮标相同。[/*]
[*]使用电鱼机每消耗 1 颗电池，即可获得钓鱼经验。[/*]
[*]电鱼机会根据你的钓鱼等级，电出对应品级的鱼类。[/*]
[*]使用时会遭受触电效果并损失生命值，务必谨慎使用！！！[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]特别感谢[/b][/size]
